The libraries support the design. crossws 0.4.12 merges the upgrade context into the peer context and sends a thrown Response as the handshake answer (adapter.mjs:42, 57-62). The iOS socket driver calls onError and then closes with 1006 when a handshake fails (NWWebSocketConnection.mm onComplete). @invertase/react-native-apple-authentication sends Apple the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw nonce (RNAppleAuthModule.m:107, RNAppleAuthUtils.m:59-68), which is what auth.ts compares.
findings.none: The library sources match the code as it is.
